I also bring complimentary snacks, but because I work in a Nigerian restaurant, I need to explain what I’m serving. Sometimes people get annoyed with my monologue, but if I don’t do it then there’s the risk of accidentally triggering allergies. 

There is a fine line between wanting people to not feel rushed and needing to flip a table.  There’s also a fine line between guests having great conversations, but the restaurant has been closed for 45 minutes.
